name: Barbell Overhead Press
cues: Start with the bar on your front shoulders, grip just outside shoulder width
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core
Press straight up, tipping your head back to clear the bar
Bring your head forward once the bar passes your forehead
Lock out with the bar over your midfoot
